title: Surfacing the Unsaid: CUE-Bench for Affective Stance in Chinese Discourse
abstract: arXiv:2608.10810v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Emotion understanding in discourse requires reasoning beyond surface sentiment because speakers often convey affect through indirect, implicit, polite, ironic, or deliberately mismatched expressions. Existing emotion benchmarks mainly annotate surface polarity or final emotion categories, while lacking a structured account of how explicit expression, implicit affect, pragmatic intent, and fine grained emotion interact. This limitation makes current evaluations insensitive to cases where affective meaning is concealed, weakened, inverted, or pragmatically reshaped, thereby obscuring model failures in deeper emotion understanding. To address this gap, we introduce CUE Bench, a Chinese Unsaid Emotion benchmark that centers on Affective Stance and covers diverse communicative scenarios. translated_title: 揭示未言之意：面向中文语篇情感立场的CUE-Bench基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.10810v2 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：语篇中的情感理解需要超越表面情感的推理，因为说话者通常通过间接、隐含、礼貌、讽刺或故意不匹配的表达方式来传达情感。现有情感基准主要标注表面极性或最终情感类别，而缺乏对显式表达、隐式情感、语用意图和细粒度情感如何相互作用的系统化描述。这一局限性使得当前评估对情感意义被隐藏、削弱、反转或语用重塑的情况不敏感，从而掩盖了模型在深层情感理解中的失败。为解决这一空白，我们引入了CUE-Bench，一个中文未言情感基准，其核心是情感立场，并涵盖多样化的交际场景。CUE-Bench通过显式-隐式极性交互构建了九种人类可解释的情感立场，并进一步提供了意图和细粒度标注。
tldr: 该论文提出了CUE-Bench，一个中文未言情感基准，通过显式与隐式极性交互构建九种情感立场，系统化捕捉语篇中隐藏、削弱或反转的情感意义，以提升深层情感理解的评估能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CUE-Bench, a Chinese Unsaid Emotion benchmark that constructs nine affective stances from explicit-implicit polarity interactions, systematically capturing concealed, weakened, or inverted affective meanings to enhance evaluation of deep emotion understanding.
